stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Grandma Chen made the best rice cakes in the family.”?
options: Each student brought one family recipe and wrote a short story about it.
Everyone loved them, but she never wrote down the recipe.
She carried it everywhere and wrote down words she did not know.
Not everyone loved the rule, and some still wanted their phones back.
